description: Tier-3 Full probe evaluation of discrete symbol density subsets (SD8, SD16, SD32, SD64, SD128) on Caltech-256 for 30 epochs
command: python -m benchmarks.make_val_split --h5 $TIER1_CACHE_DIR/caltech256_elic_latents.h5 --out /kaggle/working/val_split.npz && python -m benchmarks.train_probe --symbol-density 8 16 32 64 128 --arch latent_head --quant-modes quantized --stem-channels 256 --weight-decay 1e-3 --label-smoothing 0.1 --spatial-dropout 0.05 --drop-path 0.1 --latent-shift 1 --cutmix-p 0.2 --cutmix-alpha 1.0 --seed 42 --epochs 30 --early-stopping --patience 5 --in-memory --profile --batch-size 128 --val-split /kaggle/working/val_split.npz --symbol-density-samples 2000 --out-dir /kaggle/working
